teaser: Cedar is mature and adopted; it lacks the why, the version in force and the evidence. A vault carries all three, and the demo shows it working.
core_idea: Cedar, open-sourced by AWS in 2023, in the CNCF Sandbox since October 2025 and used by AgentCore Policy to check agent tool calls, already expresses most of an agent behaviour policy: permit for the grant, forbid for the barrier, entities for the footprint; it does not carry why a rule exists, which version was in force, or what it decided, and an sgit vault carries all three, as a local demo showed with a validation gate, signed tags, read-only enforcement clones and a sealed, hash-chained append lane of decisions; it also showed that Cedar skips a policy that errors, so an invalid forbid fails open, and the MVP must validate before release and deny on error.
